name: 钉钉
description: 钉钉 MCP：通讯录、部门、机器人消息/DING、待办、日程、工作通知、日志等能力。扫码登录即可用，无需创建应用。

composer.prompt: 使用钉钉插件查询或处理待办、日程、消息和审批相关事项，涉及写操作前先确认范围。

setup.instructions: 无需创建应用：首次使用先安装 dws CLI（curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DingTalk-Real-AI/dingtalk-workspace-cli/main/scripts/install.sh | sh），然后在终端运行 dws auth login，用钉钉 App 扫码授权一次即可，后续自动续期。
setup.primaryCta: 查看 dws 安装与登录指南

en.description: DingTalk MCP: contacts, departments, robot messages/DING, todos, calendar, work notices, and reports. Scan-to-login, no app creation required.

composer.prompt: Use the DingTalk plugin to query or handle todos, calendar, messages, and approvals; confirm scope before write actions.

setup.instructions: No app creation needed: install the dws CLI once (curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DingTalk-Real-AI/dingtalk-workspace-cli/main/scripts/install.sh | sh), then run `dws auth login` in a terminal and scan the QR code with the DingTalk mobile app. Tokens renew automatically afterwards.
